_doc: The five fixed region-edit cases. Each case = one source brief + mask(s) + one task per region semantic. The live bench (scripts/e2e_region_fanout.py) mints the source inside a workspace by running the named source brief (bench/briefs.json, role=region_source) on the preset and seed under source_generation, then creates the regions by uploading the mask PNGs verbatim. Masks are white-on-black and source-size, generated by bench/make_fixtures.py: plain ellipses and rectangles placed where the objects land when the source is minted on the recorded runtime. The committed source.png files are synthetic layout diagrams from the same script, not model output, so the bench reports the minted source as different from the committed one; that is expected. If a source is minted on a different runtime pin, re-verify mask placement visually before benching.

source_generation.committed_sources: synthetic layout diagrams (bench/make_fixtures.py), not minted images

cases.turn_prompt: cluttered wizard's study at night, bookshelves and glowing runes, warm candlelight
cases.expect: astrolabe byte-preserved (nd3-v1 KEEP composite); background regenerates to the turn prompt; no seam halo at the mask edge

regions.name: glass
regions.prompt: swirling blue magical flame filling the glass, cool arcane glow

cases.expect: flame turns blue/arcane and the glow rebalances inside the panes; lantern frame, crate, and background untouched; lighting on the frame plausibly follows the new glow

regions.name: teapot
regions.prompt: an ornate engraved silver goblet on a small wooden stand

cases.expect: copper teapot replaced by a silver goblet composited coherently (correct scale, window light, contact shadow); rest of the table setting untouched
central barrel removed, cobblestones continue coherently through the fill (pattern, moss, perspective); courtyard otherwise untouched

cases.semantic: multi-region combo (KEEP + REPLACE + DELETE in one turn; exercises the full nd3-v1 precedence + regenerate-unclaimed rule)

regions.name: scale
regions.prompt: a small brass orrery with tiny rotating planets

cases.turn_prompt: alchemist desk at cold blue dawn, morning light through a window, candles extinguished
cases.expect: flask byte-preserved; scale becomes an orrery; small bottle removed with clean fill; ALL unclaimed pixels regenerate to the dawn re-brief (a KEEP region exists, nd3-v1); precedence honored where masks would contend
